hooks.command: f=$(jq -r .tool_input.file_path); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/dist/*) echo "dist/ is generated by gulp and wiped on every build. Edit src/ instead." >&2; exit 2;; esac

f=$(jq -r .tool_input.file_path); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/src/js/*.js) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/node_modules/.bin/jshint "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/src/sass/*.scss) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/node_modules/.bin/sass --no-source-map "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/src/sass/styles.scss > /dev/null || exit 2;; esac
